journey.name: Today
journey.description: The app opens on Today. With nothing planned it leads to Set up and to the plan; a session planned for today is up next there and starts from it; a preset that fits a few minutes starts from "Or pick by time", and so does the flow that fits; and a program followed puts its next day up next, saying about how long it takes. A line under the title says what kind of day it is; once today's steps are done the day says so, and a day with nothing planned is a rest day. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On the welcome, which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip to Set up", then "Skip for now" on "Set up"
Verify that the Today tab is shown and selected, with "This week" and "Nothing planned" over "Set up your week", "Plan your week" and "Follow a program"
Tap "5 min" under "Or pick by time"
Verify that "Tabata" is listed over "Conditioning · 20s on · 10s off · ×8" and "4:00", and under the presets "Daily five" over "Mobility · 5 moves" and "5:00"
Tap the "Tabata" row and verify that a sheet opens with "Conditioning" and its length over "Tabata", its timeline, "Start" and "Plan for later"
Tap "Start"
Verify that the workout shows "Get ready", then tap "Skip" and verify "Work" and "Round 1 of 8"
Tap "End", then "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the Today tab is shown again

Tap the "Daily five" row, verify that its sheet lists "Cat-cow" to "Downward dog", tap "Start" and verify that the workout shows "Get ready" with "Cat-cow" and "Move 1 of 5"; tap "End", then "End workout"
Tap "Plan your week"
Tap the "+" on today's weekday row in "Routine"
In the "Add to plan" sheet, tap "Lift", then "Add to plan"
Tap "Back"
Verify that Today shows "Up next · Today" with "Lift session" and a "Start session" button
Tap "Start session"
Tap "Log set", then "Finish", then "Done"

Verify that the Today tab is shown, "This week" reads "1 workout" with today's dot filled and checked in the accent, a line under the title ends "done" over "That is the day.", the card under the week says "Done for today" with the session ticked under its lift ("Two-hand swing", "Strength") and no "Start" shows, and the card after it says "Nothing more due" with "Edit plan", not "Nothing planned"
Tap "Edit plan", remove "Lift session" from today's weekday row in "Routine" (its "Remove" button), then tap "Back"
Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", tap "Follow a program", scroll to "15-minute kettlebell plan", tap it and tap "Follow this program"
Tap the "Today" tab
Verify that Today shows "Up next · Today" with "15-minute kettlebell plan", a line starting "about 15 min" before "Day 1 of 18 · week 1", and a "Start day 1" button

Tap the "15-minute kettlebell plan" title and verify that a sheet opens with "Strength · about 15 min", the day's lifts each with its sets, "Start day 1" and "Plan for later"; tap outside it to close it

Verify that the picks are folded to a row "Something else" over "Pick by time" and the length picked; tap it, then tap "15 min" under "Or pick by time" and verify that "15-minute kettlebell plan" leads the picks with "Strength · Day 1 of 18 · week 1" and "15 min"; tap "10 min" and verify that it is gone

Tap the week card's goal chip to open the plan, add "Tabata" to tomorrow's weekday row, and unfollow the program ("Stop following" at the foot of Train's Strength pillar's "All programs"); back on Today (with nothing done today, on a fresh day) verify a line ending "rest day" over "Nothing is planned today. Rest is part of the week.", a card "Rest day" with "Nothing due until tomorrow" and "Daily five" under "If moving feels good" with a quiet "Start", and under it "Up next · Tomorrow" with "Tabata" and "Do it today", with no raised Start on the tab
